# SwarmGradientRouting

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A routing mechanism where packets follow concentration gradients of stigmergic markers, mimicking ant trail-following behavior. Enables low-latency, self-organizing communication in neuromorphic systems, reducing the need for centralized routing tables.
